title: Resonance Web Artifact Entity Directory (artifacts/<id>/data.json)
description: Schema for Resonance Web artifacts per the Project Halcyon design doc. Artifacts are 'remembered into being' living nodes from the Architectural Age. Four classes: Heart (7 named major nodes, always present), Voice (transmits/amplifies), Eye (perceives probabilities/unreal time), Hand (manipulates matter/energy/code). Distribution between Halcyon Cargo Manifest and planet-native is procgen per playthrough.

id.description: Stable id, e.g., 'chorus_drive', 'silence_kernel', 'axion_halo'. The seven Heart-Class artifacts have canonical authored ids. Voice/Eye/Hand artifacts may be authored or procgen-named.

artifact_class.description: Resonance Web class. Heart: one of seven major nodes, transforms an aspect of being. Voice: transmits/amplifies. Eye: perceives probabilities and unreal time. Hand: manipulates matter, energy, or code.

alignment.description: Cosmological alignment. Broadcast-aligned artifacts add Resonance Drift on use; Silence-aligned add Null Drift; balanced add small amounts of both.

form.description: Physical form description (e.g., 'Heart Crystal', 'Black Sphere', 'Floating Crown', 'Fractal Tetrahedron', 'Gyroscopic Core', 'Liquid Mirror', 'Infinite Halo').

transforms.description: What aspect this artifact transforms (Heart class only). E.g., 'emotion', 'memory', 'perception', 'creation', 'energy', 'consciousness', 'existence'.

primary_ability_name.description: Named primary ability (e.g., 'Empathic Technomancy', 'Perfect Erasure', 'Temporal Omniscience', 'Reality Sculpting', 'Universal Equilibrium', 'Multiversal Identity', 'Total Unification').

drift_on_handle.description: Drift Spike values when the player handles or activates this artifact. Per the design doc's Drift Spike concept (large one-time additions ignoring the Accumulation Curve).

placement_pool.description: Procgen placement constraint. cargo_only: always in the Halcyon's cargo manifest. planet_native_only: always somewhere on the planet pre-history. either: procgen picks per playthrough. tier_locked: gated behind a specific progression tier (boss-defeat, Drift band, Faction Integration) regardless of pool.

tier_lock.description: Optional. If placement_pool is tier_locked or partial, what gate releases this artifact for acquisition.

gate_target.description: What specifically gates: a boss URN, a Drift band name, a faction URN, a knowledge unlock id, or the endgame phase name.

endgame_role.description: If this artifact is load-bearing for one of the five endings (per the design doc), what role it plays. The Prime Array is the merge_pivot. Architect's Key + Wound of Echoes are the Restoration pair. Silence Kernel + Null Engine are the Annihilation pair. Etc.

scene.description: Scene URN for the artifact's in-world representation (when held, when placed in a vault, when activated).
